note: Hand-labeled ground truth for same-event grouping (scripts/evalNewsClustering.mjs). ONE live pull, 2026-09-20 (24 feeds, 930 candidates after the wide pre-filter). Labeled by Claude reading headlines, not by an independent human, so treat it as a calibration aid, not a benchmark. A story = the same news development, including immediate confirmations and reactions within ~36h; two outlets reporting different sides of one development are the same story. Unlabeled articles are assumed to be distinct stories. Ambiguous articles are excluded from scoring. Positives were first mined from MiniLM similarity >= 0.55 and then checked for misses with an independent rare-shared-word search, so a small bias toward embedding methods remains. Article text is third-party RSS headline/summary excerpts kept only as evaluation input.
